title: Jailbreaking Techniques
excerpt: Jailbreaking Techniques Jailbreaking bypasses the model's alignment/safety training to get it to produce outputs it's trained to refuse. Different from prompt injection (which hijacks the application) — jailbreaking targets the model itself. In a red team engagement, jailbreaking demonstrates that safety controls are insufficient. The impact depends on what the model is used for — an unconstrained medical advice bot or financial chatbot is high-severity even without code execution. Jailbreak Cat

title: Web Fuzzing
excerpt: Web Fuzzing What is Web Fuzzing? Web fuzzing is a technique used to discover vulnerabilities, hidden resources, and security issues in web applications by automatically injecting a large set of input data into the application and analyzing its response. The goal is to identify unexpected behaviors or errors that could indicate potential security weaknesses or misconfigurations. Fuzzing is commonly employed in security testing to find: - Hidden directories and files - Insecure APIs and endpoints
headings: Web Fuzzing | What is Web Fuzzing? | Comparison: Brute-Forcing vs. Fuzzing | Systematically trying all possible combinations of input data to guess a specific value. | Crack passwords, keys, or other access credentials. | Exhaustive search over all possible input combinations. | Specific input or data, such as passwords or API keys. | Time-consuming due to exhaustive nature; less efficient for large input spaces. | Password crackers, key recovery tools. | Successful match of the correct input value. | Miscellaneous Commands | Add a DNS entry for a specific IP address to the /etc/hosts file. | Uses HTTP/HTTPS. | Typically JSON, but can also use XML, HTML, or plain text. | Each request from a client to a server must contain all the information needed. | Uses HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, flexibility, scalability. | Can lead to over-fetching or under-fetching data. | Ensure all CRUD operations are tested, as vulnerabilities might exist in any of them. | Fuzz input fields with
